question: Will Zohran Mamdani win the 2025 NYC mayoral election?
orientation: Historical YES-contract series study. Contract prices are observed market data, not a forecast or causal assessment.

market.title: Will Zohran Mamdani win the 2025 NYC mayoral election?
market.rules: YES if Mamdani wins the November 4, 2025 NYC general election; AP, Fox News and NBC agreement or official certification determines resolution.

contract.proposition: Zohran Mamdani wins the 2025 NYC mayoral election

events.title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorses Zohran Mamdani
events.mechanism: A nationally recognizable endorsement can signal outsider momentum and coalition support.

claims.text: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorses Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The observed contract response was small immediately and larger over the delayed window; this is descriptive, not causal.
events.competingExplanation: Other endorsements, polling and ranked-choice strategy were also in the information set.

events.title: Cuomo concedes the Democratic primary to Mamdani
events.mechanism: The insurgent's primary breakthrough removes the establishment favorite and changes the general-election field.

claims.text: Contemporary primary-night coverage reports Andrew Cuomo conceding the Democratic primary to Zohran Mamdani.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The primary breakthrough produced the dominant observed response in this candidate set; the concession and rolling returns are a single primary-night information cluster.
events.competingExplanation: Returns were already rolling in before the concession and other primary-night reports shared the window.

events.title: Cuomo announces he will continue as an independent
events.mechanism: A defeated rival returning to the general election preserves a credible anti-Mamdani lane.

claims.text: Andrew Cuomo announces that he will continue running for mayor as an independent.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The observed response was modestly lower; the window does not establish causality.
events.competingExplanation: The independent bid had been discussed earlier and was not wholly new information.

events.title: Governor Kathy Hochul endorses Mamdani
events.mechanism: A major party establishment endorsement can broaden coalition support for the insurgent nominee.

claims.text: Governor Kathy Hochul endorses Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The observed response was modestly higher; surrounding September campaign news also matters.
events.competingExplanation: The endorsement followed public discussions and coalition expectations.

events.title: Mayor Eric Adams ends his reelection campaign
events.mechanism: An incumbent exit changes the opposition field and possible vote distribution.

claims.text: Mayor Eric Adams ends his reelection campaign.

events.retrospectiveInterpretation: The observed response was modestly lower; it is a descriptive association, not a causal estimate.
events.competingExplanation: Withdrawal was publicly speculated about and another major anti-Mamdani candidate remained.

conclusion.title: Reveal-only resolution
conclusion.text: Zohran Mamdani won the November 4, 2025 NYC mayoral general election. The Board of Elections record is retrospective and excluded from all five pre-reveal cards.
